name: 42053 · Kevil, KY
findings: ZIP 42053 (Kevil) has 13 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 42053 (Kevil) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
